results.title: Azerbaijan Cybersecurity Center to train highly qualified personnel
results.description: Baku, October 27, AZERTACRashad Hasanov, Azerbaijan’s Deputy Minister of Digital Development and Transport, met with Alain Penel, Vice President for Middle East, Türkiye, and CIS at Fortinet company. The meeting focused on cooperation opportunities with Fortinet to train qualified local cybersecurity specialists in Azerbaijan, including the expansion of the Fortinet Academic Partner Program across higher education institutions. The sides also exchanged views on potential collaboration with the company in cloud technologies, cybersecurity solutions, and artificial intelligence tools.
